metadata.title: ASECAM — Association of Cameroonian Students in Madagascar
metadata.description: Official website of ASECAM. Mutual support, guidance and community for Cameroonian students in Madagascar.

home.hero_subheading: Bringing together Cameroonian students in Madagascar to settle in, adapt, support and empower each other.

services.title: Our services
services.arrival_desc: Support for settling in and adapting for Cameroonian students newly arrived in Madagascar.
services.networking_desc: Connecting members with professionals and opportunities to facilitate entry into the job market.
services.academic_desc: Advice and support for choosing programmes, enrolment processes and academic success.
services.directory_desc: Discover the talents and business activities of ASECAM members.

join.heading: Join ASECAM
join.text: Be part of the Cameroonian community in Madagascar. Together, let's build a strong support network.
